Official free/busy read query allows calendar.events.freebusy, calendar.freebusy, calendar.readonly or calendar. Existing Sela calendar.events(.readonly) profiles do not include these: new narrow scope is independent opt-in, with separate real browser consent; no silent scope expansion.
